topic.title: Commit Changes
topic.shortdesc: Commit changes after you stage them to create a record of work done on the staged files.

body.p: On Git Staging, enter a message in the Commit message area that describes the staged changes. Select Commit to save the staged changes to your local repository.
The toolbar above the Commit message area includes options that affect the commit:

ul.li: Generate commit message using AI - Creates a draft commit message based on the staged changes. You can customize how AI generates commit messages from the Git Client AI preferences page.
Choose a previously used comment - Reuses a previous commit message.
Amend last commit - Adds the staged changes to the most recent local commit or edits its message.
Automatically push changes to remote when committing - Pushes the commit to the remote repository immediately after committing.

note.p: If your environment is configured for commit signing, you can sign commits using SSH or GPG keys.

GPG support in JGit honors the GNUPGHOME environment variable. If set, that directory is used as the GPG home where keys are stored. If not set, JGit defaults to %APPDATA%\gnupg on Windows and ~/.gnupg on other systems. The jgit.gpg.home Java system property takes precedence over GNUPGHOME if both are set.
